e9eb52bd-d2ec-4a65-a956-ea0a4bbcd214.text: You have the right to withdraw from an order within 14 days without giving any reason. The withdrawal period starts on the day you (or a third party named by you) receive the goods.To exercise your right of withdrawal, contact the Quartermaster support chat with your order number, or send an unambiguous statement (e.g. by email to support@pirates-chest.example, a fictional address) stating your decision to withdraw. Meeting the 14-day deadline is enough -- you do not need to have returned the goods yet.

74dc1233-3d8e-4036-ab19-35ba4b76d268.text: While an order still shows as placed and has not yet shipped, you may ask the Quartermaster support chat to cancel it directly -- no formal withdrawal notice is needed in that case.

fc51bd4d-8538-47aa-a2a2-8efe6385b054.text: Demo content. The Pirate's Chest is a fictional shop built for a Spring AI / Vaadin demo application. No real orders are shipped and no real payment is processed. This page exists so the support assistant (and, later, a policy page in the UI) has realistic content to refer to.

fb448843-d85f-4ad2-b0f9-fb2e9da278be.text: Demo content. The Pirate's Chest is a fictional shop built for a Spring AI / Vaadin demo application. No real orders exist, so no cancellation or refund is ever actually processed. This page exists so the support assistant (and, later, a policy page in the UI) has realistic content to refer to.

95a58539-c3ba-476e-8597-ddd1a471cc84.text: Ask the Quartermaster in the support chat, or reach out to support@pirates-chest.example (fictional address, for demo purposes only).

8e1bee52-0d48-4676-9210-32e01069cbbc.text: If you withdraw from an order: Any payment received for that order (in this demo, none is actually collected) would be refunded within 14 days of receiving your withdrawal notice. Refunds would use the same payment method used for the original order, unless otherwise agreed. Goods must be returned within 14 days of notifying us of the withdrawal. You bear the direct cost of the return shipment. A reduction in value caused by handling the goods beyond what is necessary to check their nature and function may be deducted.

d7764be1-afce-4a14-a219-483f962f4509.text: The right of withdrawal does not apply to: Goods made to your specifications or clearly personalized (e.g. an engraved cutlass). Sealed goods that are not suitable for return for health or hygiene reasons once unsealed (e.g. an eye patch). Digital content (e.g. a downloadable treasure map) once downloading has started with your prior express consent.

aeafeb9c-9240-47e7-91cc-95c20a13b8a3.text: Delivery area: We currently deliver to all seven seas -- in practice, every country selectable at checkout. Delivery time: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days after an order is placed. Remote islands (and anywhere outside the EU) may take up to 10 business days. Shipping cost: Orders of 50.00 gold coins or more: free shipping. Orders below 50.00 gold coins: a flat rate of 4.90 gold coins. Order confirmation: After checkout you receive an order confirmation with your order number on screen; no shipment tracking is provided in this demo. Damaged or missing goods: Contact the Quartermaster support chat with your order number and a description of the issue.

5c989b53-ed63-440e-b899-96b4210cea81.text: Accepted payment methods (demo only): Gold coins and pearls, weighed and counted at the harbor master's scale. When payment is charged: In this demo, no payment is actually collected or charged -- placing an order only simulates a completed purchase. Currency: All prices are shown in gold coins and include statutory VAT where applicable. Invoices: A simple order summary is shown on the confirmation page; no separate invoice document is generated in this demo.

b3f30a36-03b1-4d5f-95a7-b689820c9b50.text: Ask the Quartermaster in the support chat, or reach out to support@pirates-chest.example (fictional address, for demo purposes only).
